title: Honor containers.conf init default for container creation
body:
Preserve omitted init option through CLI and API conversion, then resolve its default server-side using the server's containers.conf.

Explicit true and false values still override the default.

Keep infra containers from inheriting this default and preserve the original init setting when cloning containers.

Add coverage for local and remote defaults, explicit overrides, infra containers, and cloning. Document the default for --init and RunInit.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/30094
